name: personUrl
label: Person URL
help: Public or hashed LinkedIn URL of the person whose skills you want to endorse. LinkedIn lets you endorse skills only of your 1st-degree connections; for anyone else every selected skill gets Connection Not Found.

name: allSkills
label: Endorse All Skills
help: Whether to endorse every skill of the person. When on, Skill Name Patterns is ignored. When off, at least one pattern is required.

name: skillNamePatterns
label: Skill Name Patterns
help: Regular expressions that select skills by name; a skill is selected when any of them matches. Required unless Endorse All Skills is on, in which case it is ignored: an empty list fails instead of endorsing every skill. The syntax is RE2: lookaround and backreferences are not supported. Matching is case-insensitive and searches anywhere in the name: manage matches Project Management. Anchor a pattern with ^…$ to require the whole name: ^scrum$ matches Scrum but not Scrum Master. 1 to 20 patterns of 1 to 200 characters each. Skill names are shown as the profile owner entered them, in the owner's language, whatever your own LinkedIn language, so write patterns in the language of the profiles you target. A skill you have already endorsed counts as a success, and every successful endorsement counts toward the stEndorsements limit.
